controls.mutation: Delete just that typed dependency, preserve all others
controls.detection: Loss of reference edge or essential causal pathway

Original specifies K versus external coupling Gamma or E_exp

controls.mutation: Collapse distinctions between two source declared variants
controls.detection: Variant completeness/negative contrast or functional distinction failure

controls.mutation: Replace state update with input-only map
controls.detection: History witness lost and temporal requirement fails

controls.trigger: Original source has explicit adverse null, failure or limitation
controls.mutation: Delete just one material negative restriction

controls.trigger: Source has role witness outside X/K/T under existing strict forgetful-map semantics

classification.INFORMATIVE: Applicable source witness, valid destructive change, baseline FULL and mutant detected PARTIAL/FAILED
classification.NON_DISCRIMINATING: Valid mutation but source has no discriminatory warrant on changed fact; exclude from detection-power denominator
classification.INVALID: Inapplicable, invalid input, missing evidence, or baseline unvalidated
classification.FALSE_POSITIVE_RECONSTRUCTION: Source-discriminable valid mutation receives unwarranted FULL; report as evaluator defect, not control success

exposed_QP_cases: Development regressions only, cannot be reclassified independent
frozen_hist_comparator: G_dyn prior 60-claim loss retained as history; new synthetic test only exercises scoring
